transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because for the past year or so, I keep getting pulled off what I’m doing by really small things. A phone buzz, someone walking past my office, even a random thought about my in-laws—it just grabs my attention before I can stop it.
Did you experience similar difficulties with attention and distractibility while growing up as a child?

Yeah, looking back, it was there when I was a kid too. Teachers were always moving my seat because I talked too much, got up without asking, or blurted out an answer before they’d even finished the question.
Over the past year, have you been dealing with frequent, hard-to-control worry about various everyday things?
Not really. I mean, I have normal stuff to think about, but I wouldn’t say I’m worrying a lot or that it’s hard to control.
